observations.body: The passage traces Christ Jesus from divine form through servant form, human likeness, obedience to cross-death, exaltation, the given name, universal bending, and confession.
observations.label: Obedient to death—even death on a cross: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps christ jesus, servant, cross visible within its Crucifixion evidence.

payload.posture: Read Philippians 2:5–11 as its own the cross in letters and later memory crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: This later passage uses Crucifixion language inside its own argument without retelling the complete Gospel event.
